Karthik / Marissa — thanks. Elena — sorry for the inconvenience. I reviewed INV-8729 and Redwood can take one of two operational paths:

1) Reissue invoice to Nova Hospital GmbH (EU) — cleanest for VAT reporting. We’ll issue a credit for INV-8729 to Nova Hospital Ltd and reissue a new invoice the same day we receive written remit confirmation from Nova Treasury. Expected timeline: 48–72 hours after confirmation.

2) Accept payment from EU entity against the existing invoice — requires Treasury to include: PO number, EU entity name, bank remittance reference, and an explicit statement that payment is on behalf of Nova Hospital GmbH. Our tax team will then assess reverse-charge applicability and may request a supplier declaration.

If we do not receive remittance confirmation within 7 business days from the first email, standard dunning will proceed: automated reminders plus a manual collections outreach. Given the strategic nature of Nova Hospital, I recommend we hold off on service suspension, but escalate to Director level for an exec touchpoint if no commitment in 7 days.

Marissa — please prepare an exec brief and include: aging schedule, prior payment history, contract start date, and the proposed timeline for reissue vs acceptance. Jonas, please stand by for approval to send Director-level nudge if required.

Attachments: Novahospital_Remittance_Instructions.pdf, INV-8729.pdf

Thanks,
